p_fec63018a0.sentence: The harder test is whether it works with new people.
p_fec63018a0.prev: A model can look brilliant when tested on the same data used to build it.
p_fec63018a0.next: In a separate analysis of relationship predictions, accuracy dropped from 90 percent on the original data to 69 percent on different data.

p_8c525945ab.sentence: So perhaps the most useful question is not, “Can an equation tell us whether to stay together?”
